parameters.query:
SELECT
    lead_id,
    client_name,
    company,
    status,
    execution_id,
    processing_started_at,
    stuck_alert_sent_at
FROM leads
WHERE status = 'processing'
  AND processing_started_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
  AND execution_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY processing_started_at ASC
LIMIT 20;

UPDATE leads
SET stuck_alert_sent_at = NOW()
WHERE lead_id = $1
  AND status = 'processing'
  AND stuck_alert_sent_at IS NULL
RETURNING
    lead_id,
    status,
    stuck_alert_sent_at;

UPDATE leads
SET
    status = CASE
        WHEN sheets_saved IS TRUE
         AND telegram_sent IS TRUE
        THEN 'completed'
        ELSE 'failed'
    END,

    next_retry_at = CASE
        WHEN sheets_saved IS TRUE
         AND telegram_sent IS TRUE
        THEN NULL

        WHEN COALESCE(retry_count, 0) < 3
        THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '1 minute'

        ELSE NULL
    END,

    
    error_message = CASE
        WHEN sheets_saved IS TRUE
         AND telegram_sent IS TRUE
        THEN NULL
    
        WHEN COALESCE(retry_count, 0) < 3
        THEN 'Execution failed. Recovery scheduled.'
    
        ELSE 'Execution failed. Retry limit reached.'
    END,


    processed_at = CASE
        WHEN sheets_saved IS TRUE
         AND telegram_sent IS TRUE
        THEN NOW()
        ELSE processed_at
    END

WHERE lead_id = $1
  AND execution_id = $2
  AND status = 'processing'
  AND (
      (
          $3 = 'check_completion'
          AND sheets_saved IS TRUE
          AND telegram_sent IS TRUE
      )
      OR
      (
          $3 = 'recover'
          AND (
              telegram_sent IS FALSE
              OR (
                  sheets_saved IS TRUE
                  AND telegram_sent IS TRUE
              )
          )
      )
  )

RETURNING
    lead_id,
    status,
    retry_count,
    next_retry_at,
    sheets_saved,
    telegram_sent;
